hero.name: Andrea Losavio
hero.bio1: I am a <bold>Computer Engineer</bold> who graduated from <bold>Politecnico di Milano</bold> in 2019, registered with the professional board under number <link>34249</link>, section B. I have been passionate about programming since 2009, fascinated from an early age by the logic and structure behind software — exploring the fundamentals of programming, computer architecture, and algorithms.
hero.bio2: I began my career in IT consulting in 2018 and have been working as a <bold>freelancer</bold> since 2023. Today, I collaborate with companies and startups as a <bold>Senior Software Engineer & FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)</bold>, embedding into their contexts to translate business requirements into tech & AI solutions and scalable, high-performance software architectures.
hero.bio3: I've also built personal products: <link>Fast Memo</link> (2023, app and website for Android and iOS) and <linkCoolifyManager>Coolify Manager</linkCoolifyManager> (2026, mobile app with a Chrome extension for self-hosted Coolify servers).

andrealosavio.description: As a freelance Senior Software Engineer & FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer), I embed into clients' contexts to translate complex business requirements into tailored tech & AI solutions and scalable, high-performance software architectures.
achievements: Build end-to-end digital products across web and mobile: frontend with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, backends with Node.js, Express, and Prisma ORM (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Supabase), mobile apps with React Native and Expo SDK, and full UI/UX product design with Figma, from prototype to production code.

Design agentic systems and AI Engineering solutions using LLMs like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Ollama for local models: multi-agent orchestration, subagent delegation, task decomposition, custom tool/function calling, modular skills, prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, context management, and external API integration.

Developed Fast Memo, a cross-platform memo application built with React Native and Expo, featuring rich-text notes, checklists, category organization, Firebase cloud sync, and other lots of features. Open-source, available in 7 languages, and downloaded by over 1,000 users.
Built and maintained multiple open-source libraries—such as react-native-dialog and figma-node-query—providing reliable, developer-friendly tools adopted across the community.
Helped a client develop a strong brand identity that allowed them to reach a wider audience and attract more customers.
Supported a company in building a robust infrastructure, laying solid foundations for future projects.
Collaborated long-term with a company to develop some of the most widely used platforms today.
Assisted a startup during a critical product transition phase, ensuring a smooth evolution.
Helped a startup secure almost €2M investment round through product development and technical strategy.

minsait.description: Worked as a Full-stack Developer on an international e-commerce product, in a continuous feedback loop with the client to simplify funnels, reduce friction and improve flow completion.
achievements: Built full-stack features with React and Node.js, automating backend data retrieval and validation to simplify the frontend and make user journeys faster and more reliable.
Worked with PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS and Azure, analyzing queries and indexes and improving development environments.
Contributed to deployment and cloud configuration in enterprise contexts.

doing.description: Designed and evolved enterprise multi-tenant and multilingual platforms as a Full-stack Developer, focusing on scalability, component reuse and performance as sites and markets grew.
achievements: Developed reusable full-stack components and features with React, Java and Adobe Experience Manager, reducing duplication.
Made the platform easier to extend across new tenants and new content.

deloitte.description: Became productive quickly as a Junior Full-stack Developer across multiple enterprise projects, working with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, React and Adobe Experience Manager to help improve delivery speed and team autonomy.
achievements: Built a strong direct relationship with the client, gaining increasing autonomy over implementation decisions and proposing solutions that balanced budget, delivery time and long-term maintainability.
Collaborated with backend engineers on APIs, validation and data security while also working with Node.js and MongoDB.
Supported Deloitte Amsterdam on an international React delivery with fixed deadlines.
